title: Digitalis fhir-hub Implementation Guide
introduction: FHIR R4 conformance artifacts for the Digitalis FHIR interface: two contracts on two FHIR bases — Prescriptor, the prescribing sessions of $formulary-session, $createrx-session and $session-result, and Surveillance, whose $check-medication-request weighs proposed prescriptions against a patient's dossier and whose $check-medication-statement checks the dossier itself, both answering with the signals that fire.

list.desc: The Prescriptor session contract — $formulary-session, $createrx-session and $session-result — and the surveillance contract on a second FHIR base: $check-medication-request weighs proposed prescriptions against a patient's context, $check-medication-statement checks a patient's current medication with every entry under test, and both answer a Bundle of DetectedIssue. Draft: a breaking change can still arrive at a minor version.
